d: Long, straight midnight-blue hair with blunt-cut bangs falls over a youthful, adolescent face with wide, muted grayish-brown eyes and a hesitant expression. The build is petite and slender, dressed in a sailor-style school uniform consisting of a white short-sleeved shirt with navy blue stripes on the sleeves, a navy blue collar, and a matching navy blue pleated skirt. Attached to the body are grey mechanical naval riggings featuring dual cannons, metal plating, and brown leather straps with small gold emblems wrapped around the thighs.
